summary: Completed comprehensive testing of JWT authentication system for SquareOne corporate website. All authentication features working perfectly including login/register, protected routes, admin dashboard, and session management.
passed_tests: Login page loads at /login with Sign In and Sign Up tabs
User registration creates new admin account successfully
User login works with admin@squareone.in / admin123 credentials
Protected route /admin redirects to /login when not authenticated
After login, user redirected to /admin with dashboard and user info
Logout button works and redirects to login page
Admin dashboard shows Blog Posts, Jobs, Testimonials, Leads tabs
All admin management buttons are clickable and functional
Tab navigation between admin sections works correctly
JWT token generation and validation working
Token verification on page load works
Session management and automatic logout works
Error handling for duplicate emails, wrong passwords, non-existent users
Backend authentication integration with frontend working perfectly
